kicker: For the thing that won't leave
truth: You've asked three times for it to go. It's still here.
prayer: Lord, I've prayed for this to leave and it hasn't moved. Help me stop waiting for the ache to go before I trust You're still good. Let Your grace be enough for today, right where I am. In Jesus' name, amen.

verse.text: My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness.

save: Save this for what's still here
